clips.spoken: Did you know that people buy less often when they have more choices?
clips.prompt: Ultra-detailed cinematic video, 9:16 vertical. A single jam jar floats in absolute black void, warm amber light glowing from within it, fine dust particles drifting in the light, slow push-in. A calm, warm voice-over narrates: "Did you know that people buy less often when they have more choices?" As the voice speaks, a second jar fades into view beside the first, then a third, then more — appearing faster and faster, the warm light fracturing into dozens of small reflections, until two dozen jars crowd the frame in a moment of visual overwhelm. High contrast, deep blacks, fine film grain, hyper-detailed macro photography look. no on-screen text, no captions, no watermark, no logos, no visible faces, no people, no hands

clips.spoken: So they cut it down to six. Fewer people stopped — but of the ones who did, ten times as many walked out with a jar.
